physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Abell 370 is recorded here: its package frames it at 457,515 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), half the short side of its picture at its distance, a presentation value.

sources.position: NASA/IPAC Extragalactic Database (NED), Abell 0370: position from 2012ApJS..199...34W, redshift from 2016MNRAS.461..248S (https://ned.ipac.caltech.edu/byname?objname=Abell%200370); NED preferred values of Abell 0370: RA 39.97136°, Dec -1.58222° (2012ApJS..199...34W); redshift 0.3751 ± 0.0009 (2016MNRAS.461..248S)
sources.distance: Comoving distance of the redshift z = 0.3751 (NED, 2016MNRAS.461..248S) in the Planck 2018 cosmology: 1510644641.4313226 pc, from Astropy 8.0.1 Planck18.comoving_distance (Planck Collaboration 2020, A&A 641, A6, https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.06209). The project's convention for objects placed by redshift (packages/bake/cli/prepare-catalogue-points.mts).
sources.properMotion: Zero: the object is held at its published position; no motion across the sky is applied.
sources.radialVelocity: c z for the redshift z = 0.3751: the redshift written as a velocity, not a motion through space.
